items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: Oh yeah, I used to play with him a whole lot, Jack Carey, a trombone player.

ctx.x: It was before 1929. Well, do you remember any of the organized bands then, like the old, there's some left even now, like the Tuxedo? Yeah, I remember all those. Well, did their styles differ very much? Well, no. Do you remember anything about Jack Carey?
Oh yeah, I used to play with him a whole lot, Jack Carey, a trombone player.
Was that the, or Jack Carey that the, was the, that the Tiger Rag was?
